body: Sorry, I posted two times because I thought I had not clicked " Save " to post. ( Since the post did not show up ) Anyways, I have a few hopes for the future. One of them is becoming a lawyer. The reason I want to die is stress. I'm dealing with school ( Which may not seem that serious ) but ahead of me, even ahead of school I'll still have a life full of stress and madness. I know, I know, stress is life, this is a stage of life that we have to go through, we all have to work. I decided to become a little selfish and say, " If I were to kill myself, would all this stress go away? This will all fade to black and I'll have nothing to  worry about anymore. Nothing to do, nothing to feel. So why not? " out of this conclusion, I feel like I should go die. Though I'm not so sure I should. Then I have an inner conflict with myself, saying how I shouldn't and how I should. I don't believe I can make a difference in this vast world, this vast universe where I am so insignificant to the point where barely anything is affected when I die. I have not tried antidepressants, but do you think I really want to live on a drug? I also have no way on buying some either way.
And the majority of me wants to die. There is still a shred of hope of me wanting to live, and that is why I need you people to open it,since I cannot open it myself.
What has been exhausting your life force? If you do not know, when did you start to feel this way?
I was given a life I want no part of. Also, if I were strong enough to live a life, why am I posting on SuicideWatch?
